items.title: Measuring time per task in AA-Briefcase
items.summary: Agentic knowledge work can take frontier models over 20 minutes per task, as measured in AA-Briefcase, our new benchmark
items.summaryZh: Artificial Analysis发布了针对长周期智能体知识工作基准AA-Briefcase的任务耗时数据。测试显示，Claude Opus 4.8虽然得分最高但耗时较长（约23分钟/任务），而GPT-5.5（xhigh）在效率上表现突出，仅需约11分钟。GLM-5.2则是表现最好的开源权重模型，测试揭示了不同模型在输出冗长度和工具执行时间上的平衡关系。

aiReview.reasonZh: 该分析深入评估了前沿大模型在AA-Briefcase知识工作智能体基准中的任务耗时与效率。

items.title: Scaling Laws, Carefully
items.summary: Scaling laws are one of the most critical empirical findings in deep learning. The observation is simple in form: the training loss $L$ decreases predictably as we scale up model size $N$, dataset size $D$, and compute $C$, following a power-law curve, which appears as a straight line on a log-log plot. We can view scaling laws as a framework for describing the relationship between compute, loss, model size and data;
items.summaryZh: Lilian Weng撰文探讨了深度学习中的关键实证发现——扩展定律（Scaling Laws），分析了训练损失随模型规模、数据集大小和计算资源增加而呈幂律下降的规律，并讨论了如何最优分配计算资源。原始信息显示：Scaling laws are one of the most critical empirical findings in deep learning.
